title: Tesla seeing the future in high-voltage experiments

tellings.quote: was talking about how Tesla um you know, would do some of these high voltage experiments and he would say weird things like I see the future or the present or the past

plain: Nikola Tesla, the inventor known for his work with electricity, would say strange things during his high-voltage experiments, such as that he could see the future, the present or the past. Michels brings this up on an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi, passing it on from a Tesla biographer he does not name. If true, it would suggest that strong electrical fields might open the mind to time in unusual ways.
